'''The Grand Entrance and Delivery Boy Sun''' (Japanese: '''登場！！運び屋サン！''' ''He Appears!! Sun the Courier!'') is the first chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* Two months have passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.
* {{adv|Moon}} arrives in the [[Alola]] region to make a delivery. 
* Moon meets {{adv|Sun}}, a young man working to gain $1 million.
* Sun is revealed to own a [[Pokédex]].
* Sun attempts to get paid for his services from [[Team Skull]], but ends up having to fight them.
* Sun offers to help Moon with her delivery.
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
